ref.substituent_description: A pyrrolidine N is acylated as a urea C(=O)-NH-CH2CH2- to one nitrogen of a piperazine whose other nitrogen is bonded to a para-disubstituted benzene ring. The para position of that ring carries O-CH2 attached (hashed bond) to C4 of a 1,3-dioxolane; the dioxolane C2 bears a 2,4-dichlorophenyl ring (Cl ortho and para to the attachment) and a CH2 (hashed bond) leading to N1 of an imidazole.
ref.notes: Typeset skeletal structure. Two hashed bonds on the dioxolane (one to the OCH2 carbon, one to the CH2-imidazole carbon). Double bonds: one C=O, three in each benzene ring, two in the imidazole.

wrong.substituent_description: Pyrrolidine N is bonded to C(=O)-NH-CH2-CH2-N of a piperazine; the other piperazine N is bonded directly to a circled benzene, which carries O-CH2 at the meta position (1,3-relationship to the piperazine N). The CH2 is joined by a hashed bond to a carbon of a 1,3-dioxolane (C, O, C, O, C); the ketal carbon of the dioxolane bears a 2,4-dichlorophenyl (Cl ortho and para to the attachment) and a hashed bond to CH2 that is bonded to N of an imidazole-type ring (N-C-N pattern, two C=C/C=N double bonds drawn).
wrong.notes: Handwritten black ink. NH is written as N with H beneath it. The five-membered N-heterocycle at the bottom right is drawn with alternating double bonds (C=N on left side, C=C on right side); both benzene rings are circles. Two hashed bonds, no solid wedges.

correct.substituent_description: A pyrrolidine N is bonded to a C(=O) which is bonded to NH-CH2-CH2- attached to one N of a piperazine; the other piperazine N is attached to a para-disubstituted benzene (circle) whose other para position carries O-CH2 joined by a hashed bond to C4 of a 1,3-dioxolane. The dioxolane C2 carries a 2,4-dichlorophenyl ring (Cl ortho and Cl para to the attachment) and a hashed bond to a CH2 that is bonded to N1 of an imidazole ring drawn with two explicit double bonds.
correct.notes: Double bonds: one C=O (top), two in the imidazole ring. Benzene rings drawn with circles, imidazole with explicit double bonds. Two hashed bonds, both on the dioxolane ring carbons; no wedge and no written stereo labels.

ref.substituent_description: From left to right: a pyrrolidine ring whose N is bonded to a C(=O) carbonyl (urea), then NH, then CH2CH2 to one N of a piperazine ring; the other piperazine N is bonded to a para-disubstituted benzene ring whose para position carries O-CH2 leading (via a hashed bond) to C4 of a 1,3-dioxolane ring. The dioxolane C2 (quaternary carbon between its two ring O atoms) bears a 2,4-dichlorophenyl ring (Cl ortho and Cl para to the attachment point) and, via a hashed bond to a CH2, an imidazol-1-yl ring (N-linked).
ref.notes: Typeset drawing. Double bonds: 1 C=O, 3 in the central phenylene, 3 in the dichlorophenyl, 2 in the imidazole (C=N and C=C). Two hashed wedges, no solid wedges, no written stereo labels.

wrong.substituent_description: Left to right: pyrrolidine N bonded to a C(=O) that bonds to NH, then a CH2CH2 chain to one N of a six-membered diaza ring (N at 1,4 positions) whose other N is bonded to a benzene ring (circle). That benzene carries, meta to the N, an O-CH2 group going by a hashed bond to a five-membered ring with two O atoms (dioxolane); the ring carbon between the two O atoms bears a 2,4-dichlorophenyl (Cl ortho and Cl para to the ring attachment) and a hashed bond to CH2 attached to N of a five-membered ring with two N atoms (imidazole, two double bonds drawn).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: central N-containing ring has a long left edge, could be read as six or seven-membered; counted as six
double bonds in the imidazole drawn as close double strokes
wrong.notes: Handwritten, long horizontal layout. Double bonds counted: carbonyl C=O, and two in the imidazole (one C=N, one C=C). Two hashed wedges, no solid wedges.

correct.substituent_description: Left to right: pyrrolidine ring N bonded to a C(=O) that is bonded to NH; NH-CH2CH2 linked to one N of a piperazine ring; the other piperazine N is bonded to a para-disubstituted benzene (circle) whose para position carries O-CH2, and that CH2 is bonded by a hashed bond to C4 of a 1,3-dioxolane (two ring O). The dioxolane C2 carries a 2,4-dichlorophenyl ring (circle, Cl ortho and Cl para to the attachment point) and a hashed bond to a CH2 that leads to the N1 of an imidazole ring.
